candidates.change_summary: Change pot update from pot += msg.value to pot += 0 so pot never accumulates.
Delete pot = 0 so after a win pot is not reset to zero.
Remove the payable sender transfer of the pot so the pot stays unchanged after a win.
Change win condition to always true by setting random = 0, always draining the pot.
Change win condition to never true by setting random = 1, so pot never drains.
Delete require statement so calls with wrong msg.value still add to pot and affect its state.
Change require to accept any msg.value so pot increases differently.
Change pot increment to a constant so pot value differs.
Change random source so winner selection behavior changes observably.
Flip winner condition so pot distribution behavior differs.
Change fee transfer to a different constant so bank balance differs.
Change winner payout to exclude fee so winner receives less.
Delete pot reset so subsequent plays see higher pot.
Delete fee transfer so bank never receives fee on win.
